headline: The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is $100 off, matching its best price to date
summary: The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is currently $100 off, priced at $699.99. This deal matches its all-time low price point. It's Apple's most capable smartwatch, featuring extensive tracking and long battery life.

headline: Ford promises not to sell your driving habits to data brokers
summary: Ford has vowed to never sell customer driving data to third-party data brokers. This new privacy promise aims to distinguish Ford from competitors. The move follows backlash against other automakers for sharing telematics data.

headline: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
summary: Anthropic has updated Claude Code to prevent its AI from recreating existing video games. The change addresses a trend of AI-made retro game decompilations and ports. Claude can still create original games, but not clone existing ones.

headline: Xbox’s former COO has ‘serious concerns’ about her abrupt departure
summary: Xbox's former COO, Helen Chiang, suddenly left Microsoft less than two weeks after a promotion. She had been with the company for 21 years before her abrupt departure. Concerns have been raised regarding the suddenness of her exit.

headline: Gearbox Calls on Fans to Help Shape the Next Borderlands, Teases 'Exciting Overall Direction' For the Future of the Franchise
summary: Gearbox is soliciting fan input for the next Borderlands game. The developer is working on an "exciting overall direction" for the franchise. This initiative aims to involve the community in shaping the future title.

headline: Nintendo Explains Why It Chose to Do Another The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake
summary: Nintendo has explained its decision to develop another Ocarina of Time remake. The company provided a rationale behind revisiting the classic Zelda title. Details regarding the remake's purpose have been revealed.

headline: Latest Steam Hardware Survey Shows Just How Hard PC Gamers Have Been Hit by AI
summary: The latest Steam Hardware Survey indicates PC gamers are increasingly reverting to older hardware. This trend follows continuously rising hardware prices throughout 2026. AI's impact is cited as a factor affecting hardware adoption.

headline: Viral 2011 Horror Hit Megan Is Missing Just Got a Sequel Series on Instagram
summary: The infamous 2011 cult horror movie, Megan Is Missing, has received an unexpected sequel. The new sequel series is available for free on Instagram. This continuation arrives fifteen years after the original's release.

headline: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
summary: Freezers in retail shops across seven European countries were targeted by a cyber-attack. Temperatures inside the affected freezers reportedly soared up to 50C. The incident severely impacted cold storage infrastructure.

headline: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
summary: Supermarkets in seven European nations were forced to discard vast quantities of food. The destruction followed a cyber-attack targeting their refrigerators and freezers. The attack rendered significant amounts of perishable goods unusable.

headline: Channel 4 documentary and journalists 'poisoned the well' against Russell Brand, court hears
summary: Russell Brand's defense barrister claims a Channel 4 documentary 'poisoned the well' against him. Journalists are also accused of prejudicing the public and jury. The court heard Brand engaged in extensive consensual sex, none of which was unlawful.

headline: Russian bombing kills 24 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
summary: A Russian bombing reportedly killed 24 people at an aid centre in Ukraine. Local officials state 27 individuals remain missing after the attack. Nine 3,000kg aerial bombs struck a village in southern Ukraine.
